results.controls: Expand integrations, device findings, keyboard open, search, sort, Show more and refresh
results.expected: Each registry device is named once above its independent findings; standalone and shared issues remain reachable, original action targets are preserved and browsing never saves settings.
evidence: Three integration families; single device heading; independent findings; equal names, standalone and shared issue identities. Focusable issue button, exact check query and acknowledgment identity, and detail close; no attention action invoked. Parent-name search, three sort choices, 40-to-45 pagination and unchanged refresh retention. No queue removal controls or counts. Actual entity, device, shared and standalone issue dialogs review only their own current unavailable entities; unrelated unavailable siblings are excluded. Cancel and Close discard review without mutations or live services; current viewport fits.

results.controls: Open exact issue, remove its unavailable entities, details, cancel and confirm
results.expected: Collapsed and expanded queues have no removal control or count. The opened issue alone owns the reviewed scope; one guarded save commits its entities across applicable availability policies and closes quietly, preserving unrelated issues and settings.
evidence: Collapsed and expanded queues have no removal action or count. An actual shared-issue row opens its own review; Cancel keeps the dialog open, confirmation saves exactly its entity across both availability policies, then closes quietly. Unknown/off and unrelated unavailable siblings remain monitored; History navigation preserves the save and notifications stay off. Stale issue catalogs block writes and require a fresh review; rejected saves remain in the exact dialog and retry only after explicit confirmation. Closing a pending review and opening another issue isolates a late failure without a retry or leaked feedback.

results.expected: Only reviewed saved policy exclusions change; unrelated drafts and HA state remain intact.
evidence: Actual Stop, Cancel, confirm, reopen and Resume controls, with no saved-action Undo; exact two-policy exclusions; unchanged unavailable state and unrelated unsaved policy/method drafts.

results.controls: Select members, stop selected, resume selected, exclusions filter
results.expected: One save affects only selected entities; excluded members remain reachable.
evidence: Device checkboxes select exactly two entities for one save; omitted excluded members remain reachable for selective resumption; exclusion filter retains only excluded branches.

results.controls: Dirty affected policy, stale review, save failure, deliberate retry
results.expected: Block unsafe scope changes and preserve saved settings and drafts.
evidence: Actual controls block affected drafts, stale settings and changed catalogs; disconnected controls are read-only; rejected saves accept deliberate retry; lost applied-save response has no automatic retry or false success and refresh prevents a duplicate write.

results.controls: View issue, Acknowledge issue and Pause notifications dialogs, cancel
results.expected: Entity details link to the exact related issue; only the full issue view exposes its acknowledgment and notification controls.
evidence: Entity details show broader issue scope and View issue without local acknowledgment or pause. Opened exact shared issue, checked Acknowledge issue and Pause notifications labels, cancelled both dialogs and returned without sending an action request.

results.controls: Visible entity policy links and actions, retained focus, phone/desktop and themes
results.expected: Entity condition and actions need no disclosure and remain reachable without horizontal scroll.
evidence: Visible entity policy and action retain focus through rerender without Details; Stop review/Cancel work at 320, 390 and 1200 CSS pixels in light and dark; no required horizontal scrolling; primary action meets 44px touch target. Physical Safari untested.

No queue removal controls. Exact opened issue review, spaced touch targets, no dialog overflow, accent Save, neutral Cancel with no write, and one simulated single-entity policy save that closes quietly while sibling findings remain.
History opens as a separate selected primary page and keeps actual recorded outcomes.
